blocks.html: 29ft Catamaran Center Console – Private Fishing Charter in San José del Cabo

The 29ft Catamaran Center Console offers a distinctive private fishing experience for groups of up to six guests departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

Unlike traditional single-hull fishing boats, this 29-foot catamaran features a twin-hull design that provides a wide, stable fishing platform. Its spacious open deck allows anglers to move comfortably while fishing, making it an appealing choice for families, groups of friends, and experienced sportfishing enthusiasts.

Equipped with twin outboard engines, comfortable seating, and an onboard toilet, this boat combines practical fishing space with convenient amenities. Its center-console configuration provides good access around the deck when fighting fish.

Fishing trips explore the productive waters of the Sea of Cortez, where seasonal opportunities include yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo, and marlin. Fishing locations are selected according to weather, ocean conditions, and recent fish activity.

Each private charter includes fishing equipment, bottled water, and soft drinks. Fishing licenses, bait, meals, transportation, and other services should be confirmed before departure.

Private fishing charter for 1–6 guests. Contact Exotic Fish Cabo for current pricing and availability.
